answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by binding identities to bonded collateral and shared evidence: when k coordinated identities equivocate, correlated penalties scale as O(k^2), while detecting a controlled swarm applies an exponential multiplier to aggregate capital loss. Splitting stake among sparrow, reef, and umber aliases therefore cannot dilute accountability; escrow seizure and asymmetric depreciation make coordination progressively uneconomic.
